cases.research_question: Which time-sliced Mōri territorial extents can be normalized into reviewed Geometry evidence for Motonari's 1523-1571 authority?
cases.review_reason: P14-D normalized two authoritative bibliographic targets for Mōri territorial expansion: Mōri Museum 『毛利氏の関ケ原』 pp.6-7 with reported map states for 1523, 1555, 1557 and c.1569, and 『毛利元就展 その時代と至宝』 p.257 with reported states for c.1523, 1530, 1541, 1554, 1557 and 1569 inside Motonari's interval. Hiroshima chronology independently supports the transition anchors. The actual map pages were not directly inspected in P14-D, so no polygon, Source UUID, Geometry or TerritoryRecord was created.
